name: Accounting / rounding / precision loss
requires: a share, debt, fee, or interest conversion reachable by an unprivileged caller
attacker influence over the magnitude of at least one operand
a repeatable or batch path so a dust leak can compound
foundry fork or unit test with the real token decimals
questions: Which direction does the truncation run, and does the party keeping the remainder stay the attacker in every path that reaches it?
Can the attacker choose the small magnitude (deposit, repay, liquidate amount), or is it fixed by the protocol?
How many times can the operation be repeated per unit of gas, and is there a batch entry point that amortises each leak?
Is there a require(shares > 0), minimum deposit, or dead-share guard blocking the zero-value outcome?
Do the preview functions and the executing function use the same rounding direction, or does the preview lie in the attacker's favour?
Does the formula divide before it multiplies anywhere, and can the lost precision become large relative to the output?
Are all token decimals accounted for, and is any involved token fee-on-transfer or rebasing so amount equals received is false?
Does the interest or reward accumulator use a precision multiplier large enough that per-block truncation cannot be forced repeatedly?
false_positives: Dust that costs more gas to harvest than it is worth, with no batch path
Rounding that favours the protocol in the direction that actually matters
A require(shares > 0) already present, which blocks the zero-share case
A one-wei loss with no repetition and no amplification
Precision loss confined to a view that no state-changing function trusts
Division-before-multiplication where the operands make the loss provably zero
Rebasing-token concern on a hardcoded token that cannot rebase
Fee-on-transfer concern on a standard fixed-supply ERC20
poc_must_show: the exact rounding site exercised with numerator, denominator, and truncated result printed
the attacker net position over N stated repetitions, with gas cost subtracted
the counterparty loss over the same N repetitions
a control run with the rounding direction flipped, where the leak disappears
for fee-on-transfer, the token amount actually received versus the amount recorded
impact_bar: Reportable for a repeatable, gas-profitable extraction from other users or the protocol, or a permanent accounting drift that breaks a required operation, with total profit quantified after gas. Informational for a real asymmetry with no profitable repetition.
